recognize_zh: 數顆巨大的巨核細胞彼此相鄰聚集，核呈膨大、深染、團塊狀的雲朵形（cloud-like）或氣球狀分葉，細胞質豐富，周圍夾雜成群的紅血球前驅細胞，是 PMF 異型巨核細胞群聚的典型表現。
features: Clusters of large megakaryocytes lying adjacent to each other and near a fat space
Bulbous, hyperchromatic, clumped 'cloud-like' nuclei with abnormal lobulation
Some megakaryocytes with high N:C ratio and irregularly folded nuclei
Intervening erythroid islands with dense round nuclei and scattered eosinophilic myelocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a hypercellular marrow containing clusters of large, atypical megakaryocytes adjacent to fat spaces. The megakaryocytes have bulbous, hyperchromatic, clumped cloud-like nuclei with abnormal lobulation, and some show an increased N:C ratio. Erythroid islands and granulocytic precursors fill the spaces between clusters. Findings are consistent with the atypical clustered megakaryocytic proliferation characteristic of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin staining and driver mutation analysis are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are giant with deeply hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and mature chromatin, loosely dispersed without hyperchromatic clumped nuclei.
PV has panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size but generally normal chromatin and lacks the dense hyperchromatic cloud-like forms.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or with widely separated nuclei, accompanied by dyserythropoiesis and dysgranulopoiesis.
Tumor giant cells form cohesive keratin-positive clusters with nucleoli and lack megakaryocytic CD61/CD42b expression.
